   **Баги и стабильность.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 19 мая 2026 г. - 27 июл. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _rybu0305_, 25 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "They removed the ability to easily see the month from the top view and then switch to the schedule view. App is unusable now."
            2. _Heatmiser NeoApp_, 22 мая 2026 г., 1/5: "Apple app icon shows 31st. Should be showing the correct date! Bug only affects Apple devices and not Android"
            3. _Mumakil_, 11 июн. 2026 г., 3/5: "It’s not bad but a few changes would get it more stars. The main issues I have are in adding an entry. Why do I have to scroll through months to get to the date I want? Drop downs to select the month and year for things way in the future would be much better. Also occasionally it freezes the keyboard when I try to enter a location. This is the only app I have that freezes anytime I’m entering information so clearly a bug in the app. Lastly why does the app icon show 31 and not the current date like the iOS calendar app does?"
